precepts.text: The heads judge for reward, the priests teach for hire, the prophets divine for money, yet say 'Is not the Lord among us? none evil can come upon us.' Now there are women pastors too, which the Bible only knew under Diana of the Ephesians, which is why Paul told those women to keep silence. Therefore Zion is plowed as a field.
precepts.point: The prophets of Samaria, the northern Latino tribes, prophesied in Baal; the prophets of Jerusalem commit adultery and walk in lies, from December 25 to the ever-virgin Mary, and strengthen the hands of evildoers so the white man can do no wrong. They are all to God as Sodom and Gomorrah.
precepts.why:
Micah shows why the pastors deal falsely: “The heads thereof judge for reward”: the leaders of our people want payback, money. “and the priests thereof teach for hire”: they only teach you for hire; that is how they get their theology degrees. “and the prophets thereof divine for money”: they give you a word of knowledge only if you pay.

“yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us? none evil can come upon us.” Why do they say that? Because of all the money they accumulated. These pastors are evil men, and now you have to add evil women, because now there are women pastors. That was unheard of. The only time you hear of women being pastors is in the worship of false gods like Diana of the Ephesians. That is why Paul told those same women to keep silence in the church: they came from worshipping Diana, where the women were the mouthpiece.

“Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps”. Zion, our country, was plowed as a field because of these heads, priests and prophets, the same judgment Jeremiah 23 says came on Israel because of the profane prophets and priests.

precepts.text: Concerning the prophets that make my people err: night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision, and the sun shall go down over the prophets. The darkness on the rulers means they could no longer teach, so today they run to the white man's theology schools.
precepts.point: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner; this is the Lord's doing. Not all Jews refused him: the builders refused him, and it was the Lord's doing, so that their rejection would have him killed and bring the northern kingdom back in.

note.label: The Dividing Hatred: the Grafted in Strangers

precepts.why:
“The stone which the builders refused” is refused by the builders, the rulers, because they were in darkness. Micah shows the darkness God put on them: “Thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.” They prepare war against us, because they are teaching the wrong thing.

“Therefore night shall be unto you”. He is talking to the prophets, the elders. Night goes back to darkness, your eyes being closed. If you can't see, you start stumbling; you don't know where you're going, you're falling. That is the stone of stumbling at work.

It goes on, “that ye shall not have a vision”: your eyes are closed, you can't read the Bible no more, you can't teach the Bible no more. God stops talking to you entirely. Then “it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine”: you cannot teach correctly. So now you go to theology school and run to the white man for help: Mr. White Man, can you teach me the Bible, please? Can I go to your school and learn BS, please?

Then “the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.” The sun going down means dark: no understanding. The light is taken from them and they lose understanding.

That is why the builders refused the stone. And it was the Lord's doing: the builders rejecting him so that they would have him killed, and so bring in the northern kingdom, whereunto they were appointed. Not all Israel refused him; the builders did. And he that was refused “is become the head stone of the corner”: he becomes our king and ruler in the end.

moments.label: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

points: Like I said, I have told this story before. I have been to many Tuesday night, Monday night travelling pastor nights, and I see fifteen people, a hundred dollars each right now tonight. They are trying to figure out how much was the rent. Twenty-five hundred. Twenty people at twenty-five dollars tonight. I see it. They are not divining anything out of the Bible. When do you see any of the preachers or the prophets teaching like that? You do not see it. There is no example of that. Not one. Christ paid the people taxes. This is crazy.

The heads thereof judge for reward. The heads judge for reward. We got probably about twenty-five different shows that we have, and every week we touch a little bit on Christianity. You can hit Christianity every day all day. There are thousands and thousands of these videos of these pastors.

And the priests thereof teach for hire. What do they do? Teach for hire. The priests teach for hire. Not only does the church have to pay them to come — how much? It is a ten thousand dollar fee. And then when they come to the church they only come in there for money.

And the prophets thereof divine for money. Hold on. What do they do? They divine for money. Word for word, script for script. And you know what is sad? None of these Christian pastors ever say anything about it. They will not say a word about it. And guess what, that is all over the world.

I am going to tell you a story. We were in Uganda. The brothers made it for us to be able to teach at a refugee camp almost at the South Sudan and Uganda border. And he figured, we got some American pastors coming. Where do you think he thought we were going to teach? He thought we were going to run them pockets. So he was happy when he saw us. He was happy, like, oh yeah, we are going to have three services for you all. We said, we are going to get three chances to speak? Yeah, you all are going to get three chances to speak.

We start teaching. Faces start cringing up. It got so bad he took the mic from my hand. He ended the service. He said, hey listen, I am going to let you finish at the second service, you were doing great. I said, okay, cool, all praises. We go outside, we shake everybody's hand. He is like, what time does the second service start? He said, about an hour. Okay cool, we are going to do some flyer missions and then we are going to come back. He called us: do not come back, you all. It ain't no second service. It ain't no third service. It ain't no radio show. It is finished. Because they divine for money.

Also, what I did not mention: when they were doing the offering, the pastor goes up and fakes like he puts money in the basket, so he can motivate everybody else to give. And the only reason I saw that is because I had to leave to go to the bathroom real quick. When I came back they were giving offering and I saw him just put his hand in there. But when I look in the basket, it is empty. The basket is empty. I am like, what is he doing? There ain't nothing in there. So this is a true story. That is all the way in Uganda at a South Sudanese refugee camp. They ain't got no money to give to nobody. They are literally escaping civil war and they are still trying to take whatever they have got.

The clip: a question about doing apologetics. I like to go out and do apologetics from time to time, get out there with the Jehovah's Witnesses, the Mormons, but there is one group that I consistently run into a struggle with, and I do not know if it is internal, black Hebrew Israelites.
It is one group. Who do you think that one group is? The Israelites. It is one group that they cannot beat. I cannot beat them. Everywhere I go they defeat me. It is like I am fighting Neo.
And now, what is crazy is he is us. He is our people. You all get that right? It is only our people that come against us. Our people come against us harder than anybody else.
The clip continues: you know, I get why it is such an enticing theological perspective, especially among the black community, because of the way that it is speaking towards people's identity.

But they always say that identity. They get mad when we say that. They get mad when we bring up identity. Meanwhile Christ stated who he was, where he is from. Paul stated where he is from. Everybody stated where he was from. The person they love the most, which is Paul — Paul said, I am from the tribe of Benjamin. He stated it millions of times. He made it known: I am an Israelite, circumcised on the eighth day, of the stock of Benjamin. He made it known. But when we do it, they have got a problem with it. I am confused.

The clip continues: do you think it is wise to engage with them when they are out proselytising, or are there different ways that you think we could go about trying to engage people in that community to bring them the gospel? Yeah, I would definitely say it is unwise to engage with them out on the street.

All right, that is all I wanted you all to see on that one. But he says run. Do not deal with them. Your own people. But you see, he ain't a top guy. Because remember when the scripture says, if you leave him alone, what is going to happen? What did they say about Christ? If we leave him alone, all men will follow after him. All men. That is why they tried to send — they tried to send Pastor Pam. Pastor Pam got beat. He got shut down. Now he is in here with us. Shout out to Austin. All praise. But now they are trying to find their next champion. You notice it has been quiet. They send all these little TikTok people. Somebody else will be coming, and he will get shut down too.
The clip: this epistle to you on the fourteenth day of my kidnap. I am not here willingly, but I am here by his grace.

Did he say kidnap? So pause. If you did not know, Brian K is one of these money pastors. What they call prosperity doctrine or prosperity gospel pastors. I remember I was about thirteen or fourteen. He came to my church. He is from Jacksonville. They came to my church, did the same thing. I see this amount of money, I see a Toyota Corolla, all these different things. He has been doing this for years. Anyway, he got caught up, did not pay his taxes. He is in jail right now. So he is writing a letter to the church as if he is a disciple that is locked up. So this is what you all are reading.

Are you serious? Ain't nobody kidnapped you. You are in prison because you are a felon. You are in prison because you committed fraud. Ain't nobody kidnapped you. When did Paul or anybody say, I am writing to you because I have been kidnapped? Are you serious? Although Paul was literally locked up because of the gospel. You got locked up because of your love for money.

The clip continues: it is no fun being held hostage by the FBOP. But nevertheless, the steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord. Even here, I know he is with me. Let me first say that being here is not hard in the sense of the environment. I am not at a prison, I am at a camp. And the only restriction I have is I cannot leave. The first three days were the hardest. I was in a part of the prison called the SHU. I was strip searched, handcuffed, in the total works. I was in the hole. No TV, no clock, no water other than the faucet.
All right. So that is what is going on in the churches. That is how religion is used.
The clip, the Guide Logic video: it is your bloodline, it is your gospel message. You are saying that we are saved by race, not by grace. That is your problem.
You all see it is black people again, right? All these black pastors coming against us. It is all our own people.

The clip continues: I could care less if you are truly of the bloodline of Judah. You can very well be from Issachar or Benjamin. You could be an Israelite. What is the gospel? Your genealogy does not matter to me. The Bible says do not argue or get into empty talks about genealogies and bloodlines. It does not matter if you are a physical seed of Abraham. Are you a seed of the promise? How would a Hebrew Israelite deal with that passage? They would do what is called the Hebrew hopscotch. They would go somewhere else instead of dealing with what we just brought up. So you have never heard a proper defence for that? There is never a proper defence.

You all know that what we teach is the truth, right? They know that. That is the thing. They know what we teach is true, but their masters will not allow them to leave us alone. They have to come against us. They have to, because if not, all men will believe on us.

As you see, they want you to deny who you are. Christianity, white supremacy, they want you to deny that you are an Israelite. Why? They have to deal with it. They will never deal with that, because they know there is power in it.

points: A lot of people, especially in Latin America, politics is big. The next president is their saviour. The next president will solve all my problems. What you all have got to understand is that all these presidents that get put up there as heads of state, they are all set up for their own pockets, their own betterment. And the question you have got to ask yourself is, where is the church when all these injustices are going on? Where are they? Where is all thy riches? None of them are there for the benefit of our people.
The heads thereof judge for reward. All these politicians are there for their money and their riches.
And the priests thereof teach for hire. All these fake pastors. All of these people are set up for their money and their own gain.

And the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us? none evil can come upon us. And they are utilizing the Lord, or the Bible, as an example to put all of you to sleep. They are manipulating the Bible to put you all to sleep. And they make you feel that they are being blessed. But in reality, no. They are robbing the people and stealing riches, getting themselves rich in the process.
Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?
Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones; who also eat the flesh of my people.
Then shall they cry unto the Lord, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.

Night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine. Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded, for there is no answer of God.
But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the Lord, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

note.label: Micah 3: They Build Up Zion With Blood

points: Ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity; they build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us? none evil can come upon us.
Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
